name: lan-scanner
title: LAN Scanner
description: Scan your local network, identify devices, open ports and IoT firmware, and track when each device was last seen.
author: erik_meliska

commands.name: scan-network
commands.title: Scan Network
commands.subtitle: LAN Scanner
commands.description: Show devices on the local network and run a background scan

commands.name: background-scan
commands.title: Background Network Scan
commands.subtitle: LAN Scanner
commands.description: Periodic scan every 30 min (can be turned off in preferences)

preferences.name: backgroundScan
preferences.title: Background Scan
preferences.label: Scan every 30 min in the background
preferences.description: Turn off to stop the periodic background scan. Manual scans still work.

preferences.name: autoScanMinutes
preferences.title: Auto-Scan When Older Than (Min)
preferences.description: Opening the list starts a new scan if the last one is older than this. 0 = never.

preferences.name: portMaxAgeHours
preferences.title: Re-Scan Ports After (Hours)
preferences.description: Ports of a known device are re-scanned only when older than this.
